description:
Secure two-way communication between clinicians and patients, integrated with EMIS Web and SystmOne clinical systems.

The iPLATO digital Toolbar is a desktop application that integrates with EMIS Web and SystmOne to power secure two-way communication between clinicians and patients. It supports direct patient messaging, automated QOF coding, template customisation, file sharing, video consultations and multi-practice support, and works alongside Selfbook, Patient Questionnaires and Triage.
